name: Jiang Po Clay Thin-Wall Shui Ping Teapot
marketing_tip: A lightweight and elegant shui ping form in rare Jiang Po clay.
body: Expertly handcrafted from raw ore Jiang Po clay, this 160cc teapot features a delicate thin-wall construction. The classic Shui Ping shape is a favorite among connoisseurs for its perfect balance and pour.
